transcription: [002116] « N° 268 — 19 December 1874. On this day, the nineteenth day of December one thousand eight hundred and seventy four, Before the undersigned Notary Public, residing at St Romuald, personally came and appeared : Mr Joseph Bourassa, of the Parish of St Romuald, in the County of Levis, farmer, [renvoi en marge (1) : « & Misses Geneviève Cantin, his wife, that the said Joseph Bourassa doth hereby & duly authorize to the effect of these presents »], of the first part ; & Mr Duncan Dewar, engineer, & Mr George Bryan, engineer, both residing in the Parish of Notre Dame de Levis, said county, [rayé : « at the place named Hadlow Cove »]. Which said parties in the presence of us, the said Notary, have stipulated, covenanted and agreed as follows, viz : The said Joseph Bourassa & Geneviève Cantin [rayé : « his wife »] did and do hereby grant, bargain and sell, and bind and oblige their heirs, executors & administrators to warrant, guard, garanty and defend against all incumbrances, mortgages, debts, dowers, demands and all other troubles whatsoever unto the said Messrs Dewar & Bryan, accepting hereof for themselves, their heirs and assigns, That is to say : A certain lot of ground situated in the Parish of Notre Dame of Point Levis, said County, in the Division called “Hadlow Cove”, containing about seven perches & one half (French) in front, & bounded as follows, viz : to the north by the public Road or St Lawrence [river], to the south at the south part of the wharf now erected ; to the West side by George Lebreux [?], & to the East side by George Bourassa, altogether with the house, kitchen & hangar thereon built, circumstances & dependencies, as the whole is now and whereof the said purchasers do declare themselves satisfied, having viewed and examined the same. [002117] Said lot of land and premises belonging to the said vendors by & in virtue of good titles duly passed & registered according to law. To have and to hold the said lot of land and premises hereby sold, together with all the rights, privileges and appurtenances thereunto belonging, unto the said Messrs Dewar & Bryan, their heirs and assigns, to their own proper use, behoof and benefit, in full and absolute property, henceforth for ever, to the effect whereof the said vendors do hereby divest themselves of the whole in favor of the said purchasers by these presents. This sale is made subject to the payment for the future of such cens, seigniorial rights, services and dues as may be payable for the said lot of land, as well as to the payment of all taxes, either municipal or scholar, & all other taxes whatsoever which are imposed or may be hereafter imposed upon the said property — garantee of all arrears due up to date. And lastly, the present sale is further made for, and in consideration of the sum of Three hundred Pounds Currency, that the vendors hereby acknowledge & confess to have received at the time of the execution of this presents, in good current money, from the said Messrs Duncan Dewar & George Bryan, to whom said vendors give a full & entire acquittance & discharge in consideration of said payment of the said sum. Dont quittance générale & finale in faveur des acquéreurs. [002118] [clause imprimée d'hypothèque de bailleur de fonds rayée] The said vendors declaring that they transfer the policy now existing upon the said house to the purchasers, without indemnity. For thus &c. Done and passed, at the said Parish of St Romuald, in the residence of the vendors, on the day and year above written, under number Two hundred & sixty eight of the original deeds of Elzéar Hubert Tremblay, the said Notary. And the vendors & purchasers have subscribed their names with me, Notary, after reading duly made according to law. Words struck out are null. » — Signé : « Geneviève Cantin », « Joseph Bourassa », « George Bryan », « Duncan Dewar », « E. H. Tremblay, N.P. ».
